designationHistory.name: Piedras Blancas Historic Light Station Outstanding Natural Area
designationHistory.indexText: The Consolidated Natural Resources Act of 2008 established the Piedras Blancas Historic Light Station Outstanding Natural Area in California.

authority.citation: Public Law 110-229, title II, sec. 201, 122 Stat. 754, 759

designationHistory.note: The statutory name includes 'Historic Light Station'; the input name omits it.
